items.headline: Coastal Flood Advisory issued September 27 at 6:46AM EDT until September 28 at 12:00AM EDT by NWS Newport/Morehead City NC
items.description:
* WHAT...Up to one to two feet of inundation above ground level
expected in low-lying areas near shorelines and tidal
waterways with compromised dune structures.

* WHERE...Areas along the beaches, Pamlico Sound, and adjacent
tidal creeks.

* WHEN...Until midnight EDT tonight.

* IMPACTS...Up to 1 to 2 feet of inundation above ground level
is possible in low-lying areas near shorelines and tidal
waterways with compromised dune structures resulting in a low
threat of property damage. Portions of Highway 12 remain
closed between Pony Pens and the ferry dock. Low lying
property including homes, businesses, and some critical
infrastructure may still be inundated. Some roads and low
lying property including parking lots, parks, lawns, and homes
adjacent to the waterfront will experience shallow flooding.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...High tides on Sunday are around 8:20 AM
and 8:40 PM.
items.instruction:
If travel is required, allow extra time as some roads may be
closed. Do not drive around barricades or through water of
unknown depth. Take the necessary actions to protect flood-prone
property.

items.headline: Small Craft Advisory issued September 27 at 2:24AM EDT until September 27 at 5:00PM EDT by NWS Newport/Morehead City NC
items.description:
* WHAT...Seas 5 to 8 ft.

* WHERE...The coastal waters from Oregon Inlet to Ocracoke Inlet.

* WHEN...Until 5 PM EDT this afternoon.

* IMPACTS...Conditions will be hazardous to small craft.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Seas will remain elevated through this
evening in the wake of this past week's Nor'easter.
items.instruction:
Inexperienced mariners, especially those operating smaller
vessels, should avoid navigating in hazardous conditions.
